purpose: Verified contract for safe discovery of approved property legal-life content and official legal/property sources.
search_rule: Search identifies candidate content; it does not establish property identity, legal correctness or evidence.
identity_rule: Property-specific discovery requires identity checking before property-specific conclusions.
privacy_rule: Private case content is excluded from public discovery.
temporal_rule: Current, historical, superseded and withdrawn content remain distinct.
ordering_rule: Result order is relevance-oriented and must not be interpreted as legal ranking or correctness.
verification_boundary: Discovery locates approved content; it does not create new facts or legal conclusions.
